utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Hey Grandma, how's your day going?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: It's going well! I was just hanging the laundry to dry. It's a nice way to enjoy the sun and save some energy.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: That's interesting! I usually just toss them in the dryer. Do you think hanging them makes a big difference?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I think so! It keeps the clothes fresh. It's good to see you joining me today.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! It's nice to be here. So, do you think hanging clothes really saves a lot of energy?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yes, dear, that's how I've always done it. It's just my way of keeping things tidy and useful.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I see, maybe I should try it your way sometime. Thanks for the tip!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Well, I suppose that's true! I do like to take my time and be careful on the road too.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: That's a good approach, Grandma. I guess being careful is always better.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, I'll park right over there. Let me know if this spot works for you.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yeah, this spot looks perfect. Thanks for driving us here, Grandma!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh yes, I remember you mentioned coming here. How is your art going these days?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: It's going really well! I've been working on a new piece that I'm really excited about.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I can't wait to see it! I'm glad we're parked safely and can chat for a bit.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I know, Grandma. You're a great driver! I'm just glad we're here safely.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh my, I think 'turnt up' means to have a lot of fun and get really excited, right?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yeah, that's right! It means having a lot of fun and getting really excited.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Ah, I see! Thanks for keeping me updated with the latest lingo.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: No problem, Grandma! I'm always here to help you with that.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I might need a little more practice to use 'turnt up' just right!

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Haha, you'll get the hang of it in no time! Let me know if you want to practice more.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I'd love to learn some new slang! It's always fun to keep up with what you're saying.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Sure thing, Grandma! How about we start with 'lit'? It's a fun one!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, I'm ready for the challenge! Let's see how well I can guess.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Okay, 'lit' means something is really cool or exciting. Like, 'That party was lit!' Want to try using it in a sentence?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Thank you, dear! I'm ready to learn and have some fun with this.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Great! How about you try using 'lit' in a sentence now?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, is it like when we say something is 'bright' or 'dazzling'?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Not quite, but that's a good try! 'Lit' is more about something being exciting or fun. Want to give it another shot?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Ah, so like a party that is full of life! Thank you for explaining it to me.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: No problem! It's fun to share these things with you. Do you want to try using 'lit' in a sentence again?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: How about, 'This dinner is lit!' Did I do it right?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Exactly! You're getting the hang of it! 'Lit' is perfect for when something is exciting. Want to try another one?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, that would be wonderful! It's nice to share these moments together.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Wow, that's awesome! I'm happy for you. Do you want to tell me more about what you've been up to?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I've just been keeping busy with my garden and reading. It's nice to have special hobbies to share with everyone.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I understand, Grandma. It's important to cherish those special moments. Whenever you're ready to share more, I'm here to listen.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I appreciate that, dear. Family is important, and I appreciate your care.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I get it, Grandma. Family is everything. Let me know if there's anything I can do to help.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, that sounds like fun! I'm looking forward to our next visit.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I'm glad you're excited, Grandma! We can plan something special together.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I've heard you mention 'FOMO'. It stands for 'Fear of Missing Out', right? It's when people worry about missing something exciting.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Exactly! Thanks for explaining that, Grandma! You're really keeping up.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm sorry to hear you won't be here for my birthday, but I understand you're busy. We'll share lots of pictures with you.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I'm really sorry I can't be there, Grandma. I'll definitely call and maybe we can do a video chat to celebrate together!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, 'stan' is a term used to describe someone who is a very enthusiastic fan, right? Like being a super fan of someone.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Thanks for explaining that too! I guess I'm a stan of my favorite band then.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: And 'sauced' is when someone has had a bit too much to drink at a party, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Got it, thanks for clearing that up! I learn something new every day.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Well, I might not know all the latest slang, but I'm always happy to learn from you!

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: You're doing great, Grandma! It's fun sharing these things with you.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, 'idear' is just a playful way some people say 'idea'. It's like a fun little twist on the word.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: That's interesting! I love learning these little quirks of language.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I think it's lovely how language can have so many fun variations like 'idear'.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Got it, Grandma! It's always fun to learn something new from you.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, that was such a fun day! I was so happy to see everyone together.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: It really was a great day! I'm glad we could all be together.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I wasn't 'sauced', just a bit overwhelmed with joy! It's funny how you remember the party.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Haha, I guess 'sauced' just meant you were having a lot of fun! I'm glad you had a good time.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Well, I appreciate you being there with me that day. It was a memorable party!

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I'm really glad you enjoyed it, Grandma. It was a special day for all of us.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I know, and I'm grateful we could share it. It was a day to remember!

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: It really was! I'm always here to spend time with you, Grandma.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, you kids and your funny words! I remember the day quite well and was just enjoying myself.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Haha, yeah, we do have some funny words! I'm glad you enjoyed yourself, that's what matters.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: And 'lit' is when something is really exciting! I'm starting to remember these.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Exactly, Grandma! It's great that you're keeping up with the new lingo.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I suppose I've had my moments of being 'lit' in my own way! It's all about enjoying life.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Absolutely, Grandma! It's all about having fun and making memories.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Well, I'm glad to hear you think so! It's so important to cherish these times.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yeah, and it's even better when we can share those moments together!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: And 'shook' means you're really surprised, right? Like if I won the lottery!

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Haha, yeah, exactly! It's cool that you're keeping up with them.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh my goodness, that would definitely leave me 'shook'! What a wonderful surprise.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yeah, surprises can be really fun! I'm glad you like learning these new words.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Ah, 'woke' means being aware of important social issues. It's good to be conscious of the world.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: That's a great explanation, Grandma! It's important to stay informed.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Well, I try to understand the important issues, dear. It's always good to keep learning.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: You're right, Grandma. It's amazing how much there is to learn every day.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: And a 'darty' is just a party during the day? That sounds like a lovely way to enjoy the weather.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Exactly! Thanks for explaining that, Grandma. You've got it.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I see! Well, as long as you're having fun and staying safe at those parties, that's what matters.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I'll make sure to have a good time and be careful.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: It's always interesting to learn these new things from you.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I'm glad you think so, Grandma! I love sharing things with you.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I've learned so much about 'darties' and 'lit' today! It's fun to hear your slang.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Haha, yeah, those are the fun ones! I'm glad you're keeping up, Grandma.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yes, dear? Is there anything else you want to teach me?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Thanks for always being so open to learning, Grandma. It makes our talks so much fun!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh my, a quiz! I'll have to remember everything we talked about. Challenge accepted!

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Haha, alright! I'll come up with some good ones for you. Get ready, Grandma!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: It's nice to learn about your world. It helps us stay connected, even with all these changes.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: No worries, Grandma! I can show you anything you find confusing. It'll be fun to learn together!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I see it now! Thank you for showing me how that works, dear. I'll give it a try.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: You're welcome, Grandma! I'm glad I could help. Let me know if you need anything else.
